mapper.select: SELECT * FROM qt_daily_contents ORDER BY qt_date DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qt_daily_contents(id, qt_date, title, scripture_reference, scripture_text, commentary, hymn, scripture_text_ko, commentary_ko, hymn_ko) VALUES(#{id}, #{qtDate}, #{title}, #{scriptureReference}, #{scriptureText}, #{commentary}, #{hymn}, #{scriptureTextKo}, #{commentaryKo}, #{hymnKo})
mapper.update: UPDATE qt_daily_contents SET title = #{title}, scripture_reference = #{scriptureReference}, scripture_text = #{scriptureText}, commentary = #{commentary}, hymn = #{hymn}, scripture_text_ko = #{scriptureTextKo}, commentary_ko = #{commentaryKo}, hymn_ko = #{hymnKo}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
